item.title: 112 Posts And Memes Restaurant Workers Might Relate To Way Too Much
item.description: Millions of people work in the food service industry, which means that millions of people might be seeking an outlet for the trauma, chaos and exhaustion that tends to come with it. But between the long hours, satisfactory pay, who has the time or money for therapy? Here's a bunch of deliciously relatable and hilarious restaurant memes and posts instead...

item.title: 116 People Share Things They Thought Were Normal Until They Realized They’re Neurodivergent
item.description: For many people, the realization doesn’t come all at once. It’s a slow accumulation of moments where something clicks and past behaviors suddenly make sense. These shared experiences highlight traits people once brushed off as quirks, habits, or personality traits, only to later view them through a very different lens.

item.title: 63 Traditions From Around The World That Are So Strange Or Stupid, They Feel Made Up
item.description: Regattas on dry riverbeds, chasing a wheel of cheese down a hill, and chucking pumpkins out of DIYed canons and trebuchets – these are just some of the wildest traditions that people in different countries have. In a recent online thread, folks have been sharing the most annoying and silliest festivals, customs, and celebrations that are a tad peculiar but that people still refuse to let go. It's just another reminder that people can be weird no matter where they live!

item.title: Nightmare Neighbors Keep Complaining About Family’s Backyard, Get Caught Secretly Using It Without Permission
item.description: The supposed joy of having a cozy home in a vibrant neighborhood can be easily ruined by nightmare neighbors. This was the headache a woman had to deal with involving the couple who lived next door to her. It all reached a boiling point when the entitled folks began breaking into her backyard, prompting her to hatch a plan that would painfully shame them.

item.title: 36 “Adult Goals” People Think Are Way Overrated
item.description: Growing up and becoming a productive member of society can mean different things, but it usually involves learning a bunch of skills that make you more self-sufficient. And yet, despite your independence, society also puts a lot of pressure on you to conform and have specific ambitions. However, definitely not every goal is worth the time and effort. item.title: 75 Unfortunate And Stupid Fails That Must Have Been Very Expensive (New Pics)
item.description: We’re all human, and we all make mistakes. It’s what we tell ourselves when things go wrong, and for the most part, it’s true. But not all mistakes are created equal: breaking a plate is unfortunate, while backing your car through the garage door stings a lot more. Here are photos of painfully expensive mishaps people shared online that may have you wincing and clutching your wallet. Some are pure bad luck, others avoidable, but all come with a brutal price tag.

item.title: 71 Times People Managed To Ruin Dessert In Ways They Didn’t Know Were Possible
item.description: Look, we all make mistakes in the kitchen. But some errors are so bad that they might just make your jaw drop. If you have a sense of humor and don’t mind poking a bit of fun at yourself, you might just be tempted to share photos of your less-than-stellar baking results online. Our team has collected some of the most disastrously delicious baking fails from the far corners of the internet. They’re a reminder that it’s okay not to be perfect. item.title: “You Can’t Live On $90K A Year!”: 44 Times Rich People Said Extremely Out Of Pocket Things
item.description: At the end of the day, we’re all humans. No matter what kinds of life experiences you’ve had, you should be able to relate, on some level, to everyone else on the planet. But it can be incredibly difficult to find anything that you have in common with extremely wealthy people. Netizens have been sharing the most insensitive and out-of-touch things they’ve ever heard rich people say, so we’ve compiled a list of their wildest responses.

item.title: Person’s Cat Starts Disappearing For Days, Turns Out The Neighbor Has Been ‘Adopting’ Him
item.description: He's not the easiest cat. High maintenance, expensive, loud and at times, destructive. But his owner adores him nonetheless. Imagine their surprise when the beloved pet started spending days away from home, coming back with mysterious wounds and gaining unexplained weight. The owner eventually found the culprit but it's become somewhat of a custody battle...

item.title: Woman Fabricates Evidence Of Cheating To Convince Friend To Dump Boyfriend, Plan Backfires
item.description: If a friend tells you your partner is cheating, it can send you into instant panic. But this woman didn’t believe it for a second. Instead, she grew fed up with her roommate, who kept joking that her long-distance boyfriend had a side chick in his new city and kept trying to “prove” he was unfaithful. What the roommate didn’t predict was that her little mission would backfire and end up exposing her instead.
